reviews.title: More money??
reviews.text: I’ve been using and enjoying this app since the beginning of 2020. Everything the app offered at that time was free, just watching some ads to earn gold coins and you were able to have all the readings you wanted. The other option was to buy gold coins so you can get the readings but I’ve always preferred the free, watch an ad to get the gold. Then they came up with the third option…..membership, of course.  Now, the very first one, watching ads to  earn gold is gone. Paying is the only option nowadays. “Buy gold to continue”?? How about “Watch an ad to earn gold” and then to continue?? Not cool to get rich by demanding money from the poor!!!

I’ve hit them up with emails multiple times and it just they just keep doing the same thing. The genie is sending me old prophecies from 2 to 3 years ago. It’s just old readings going in circle even though I still have it I was just close to being a member, but I’m glad that I didn’t especially looking at the reviews. I’m good unfortunately it is what it is. They got greedy. It’s mostly AI it has all these weird like amps I miss how like legit they were before. and the fact that I’ve emailed them for years on and off about this issue and they still didn’t fix it just shows that it says they don’t really care about the customers unfortunately it’s just about getting money at this point.
